headline: U.S. government urges Supreme Court to reverse Apple contempt ruling over App Store commission
summary: The U.S. government, alongside several legal and business groups, has filed briefs with the Supreme Court, seeking to overturn a previous ruling concerning Apple's App Store commissions in the Epic Games lawsuit.
details: The U.S. government has formally urged the Supreme Court to reverse a contempt ruling against Apple. This action is part of the ongoing legal battle stemming from the Apple vs. Epic Games lawsuit regarding App Store commissions.

This week, several legal and business groups also filed briefs with the Supreme Court, supporting the government's stance. The case centers on Apple's control over its App Store and the fees it charges developers.
caption:
The U.S. government has formally asked the Supreme Court to intervene in the Apple vs. Epic Games lawsuit.

The U.S. government has formally urged the Supreme Court to reverse a contempt ruling against Apple. This action is part of the ongoing legal battle stemming from the Apple vs. Epic Games lawsuit regarding App Store commissions.

This week, several legal and business groups also filed briefs with the Supreme Court, supporting the government's stance. The case centers on Apple's control over its App Store and the fees it charges developers.
